register_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 3A - Owner Decision Register & Governance Framework

DEC-01.title: Select Prospective Market-Data Provider
DEC-01.recommendation: Tiingo for pure daily EOD bar data ($0-$30/mo); OR Alpaca for paper order execution mocking ($0-$9/mo).
DEC-01.owner_action_required: Owner evaluates pricing, corporate actions, and API models, then selects a single primary provider.

DEC-02.title: Approve Provider Rights and Data Retention Terms
DEC-02.recommendation: Execute Personal Non-Professional Subscriber Declaration; restrict local storage to internal single-user research; zero public redistribution.
DEC-02.owner_action_required: Owner signs Non-Professional declaration and accepts data retention restrictions during account registration.

DEC-03.title: Approve Primary Scientific Endpoint & Return-Cost Tolerance
DEC-03.recommendation: Ratify primary endpoint d_t = max(0, -R_E0,t) - max(0, -R_D2,t) > 10 bps on defensive sessions with Newey-West HAC inference, and secondary full-horizon constraint CAGR_D2 >= CAGR_E0 - 200 bps.
DEC-03.owner_action_required: Owner formally ratifies statistical test specification and 200 bps annual insurance cost tolerance.

DEC-04.title: Approve Evaluation Horizon, Sample Size Floor & Stopping Criteria
DEC-04.recommendation: Approve 252-session baseline horizon with N_def >= 30 floor, contingent extension up to 504 sessions, strict prohibition of optional early stopping on favorable results, and emergency termination on > 300 bps drawdown underperformance.
DEC-04.owner_action_required: Owner ratifies duration commitment, extension policy, and termination boundaries.

DEC-05.title: Approve Monitoring, Incident Response & Evidence Retention
DEC-05.recommendation: Approve 4-tier incident severity taxonomy, disk-persisted hard-stop lock requiring physical manual reset key, and deployment of OS-level process supervisor.
DEC-05.owner_action_required: Owner reviews incident response playbook and takes custody of emergency reset keys.

DEC-06.title: Separately Authorize Forward PAPER-ONLY Evaluation
DEC-06.recommendation: MAINTAIN PERMANENT BLOCK. No activation token may be generated until DEC-01 through DEC-05 are fully resolved and signed by owner.
DEC-06.owner_action_required: Owner issues signed HMAC cryptographic activation token ONLY when fully prepared to begin paper evaluation. Live trading remains permanently banned.
